title: Repeat-Claim Coverage Share on Pocketwire Personal Account Purchase Protection
content:
The repeat-claim coverage share of the protection reimbursement on a Pocketwire Personal Account reads the purchase protection claims the customer filed within the claim look-back window, other than the claim being paid: with two or more such claims the share is 80 percent, with exactly one it is 90 percent, and with none it is 100 percent.

**Which claims count?** Purchase protection claims the customer filed inside the claim look-back window, whatever their outcome — a denied claim counts like an approved one. The claim being paid is never counted against itself, and unauthorized-payment claims are not purchase protection claims.

**What share applies?**

| Other purchase protection claims inside the claim look-back window | Coverage share |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 80 percent |
| Exactly one | 90 percent |
| None | 100 percent |

**What does the share do to a covered amount?** It multiplies it. With a hypothetical covered amount of 400.00: no other claim leaves 400.00, one other claim gives 360.00, three other claims give 320.00.
